title: 515. Number of Boomerangs

examples.explanation: Middle index 1 with outer orderings (0,2) and (2,0).
Middle index 1 sees equal gaps to the other two.

hints: Fix the middle index first, then group the other points by squared distance from it.
A group of size c contributes c*(c-1) ordered outer pairs.
Squared distances avoid floating point and fit in 64-bit math.
